description: Sets up an app: user sign-in, private records under one path, lists from a template. Returns markup and approve_url (the Site Owner turns it on). retention (shorter erases), sign_out_all and ai_read (this AI reads entries) ask first. Owner only; Free plan: testing.

template.description: Makes its app lists and plans
